primitives.name: Key Material Hashing Protocol
primitives.verbatim_quote: Store only key hashes and key ids, never raw key material.
primitives.assumptions: All key operations reference only hashed identifiers.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Loss of raw key implies impossibility of recovery.

layer2.mapping: Hashed key protocol aligns with symmetric encryption key derivation.
layer2.telemetry: Hash collision detection, key ID uniqueness, raw key attempt logs.

The schema proposal enforces a dual invariant: audit events form a cryptographically chained ledger while quotas are decoupled yet transactionally coupled with audit appends. This design supports a robust shadow seam where all mutations are logged and constrained by quota limits. The separation of concerns allows for future durable adapters to be built without altering core invariants. The append-only nature prevents data corruption and enables retroactive validation. The key hashing policy ensures no plaintext exposure, preserving security even if audit logs are compromised. The system assumes that owner approval is required for promotion to live use, enforcing a governance layer over technical capability.
